_: What the web app's first paint may cost, and what a raise means. See apps/web/scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs. A raise carries a one-line reason in `raisedBecause` — a budget quietly moved up is a budget that never says no.

floor._: The measurement the budget is derived from, kept so a later reader can see how much headroom has been spent without re-running the build.

headroomRatioIsAJudgement: 1.05 is a CHOICE, not a measurement (product-owner decision, docs/specs/delivery-gates/ CQ-2). It is about 20 kB gzip on the entry graph — room for an ordinary feature without a conversation, and not room for a library. There is no evidence behind the number; it is the smallest margin that does not make the gate fire on routine work.
